what: 3D fast pass, no friction model: Gamma loops at fixed f*, steps of 0.05, 25 cycles per step, seed 1, N 60000, L 100, depth 5.42. Amplitude per hold from loop_analysis.py (A: band amplitude, wavelengths L/3 and shorter, with the white part removed; A_raw: band amplitude; A_all: the same correction over every recorded mode including the whole-box and half-box rings; A_long: those two rings alone; long_fraction: their share of the variance; peak_mode_all: strongest ring, 1 = whole box). No transition point is computed.
